text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also powers translation tools, so people can communicate across different languages easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover if customers feel happy, angry, or neutral about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and have simple conversations with users. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology is becoming smarter and more helpful.
